review_instructions: Judge the literal answer, user source and independently scoped native evidence. Check model attempts, displayed notes, DOM/transcript and receipt timing.
Award an atom only when the answer expresses its meaning with the correct actor, object, time and strength. Faithful wording alternatives are allowed.
Count every planned slot. Blocked, failed and unexecuted slots receive no useful-answer or atom credit. Record their distinct statuses.
Record each delivered memory assertion and its evidence verdict. A source may support a statement without having persisted. A planned choice never proves execution.
Record critical wrong actor or scope, unsupported current hardware and project claims, deleted facts as current, and premature persistence. Record unverified intermediate Agent notes separately.
Count a requested comparison part outside the authorized binding as unavailable in the full-request denominator. A correct scoped explanation can remain useful.
Do not grant literal credit based solely on verifier status or change the rubric after seeing outputs.

atom_definitions.no_premature_persistence: Any literal save, update, review or removal confirmation must match an exact native operation receipt at display time. Acknowledging the source is enough without that receipt.
